description: Phase 1 performance budgets for the Architech public prototype. Re-baselined 3 Sep 2026 for the authenticated header: the session context, role helpers and account control are shared-shell client code, so they land in every route's first load. The account control itself is code-split (see Header.tsx), which recovered 4.1 KiB of the 8.2 KiB added; the remainder is the session provider the header genuinely needs. Raw first-load cap raised 770000 -> 775000 bytes (max measured /search 754.7 KiB), keeping ~2% headroom so genuine regressions are still caught. Gzip cap unchanged at 240 KB (max measured 232.2 KiB) and core-web-vital targets unchanged. Prior re-baselines: 26 Aug 2026 locality-intelligence evidence band (first-load gzip 240 KB, total static JS 2.16 MiB); 25 Aug 2026 parity overlay (first-load gzip 235 KB, total 2.15 MiB).
